proposed_memory.attempted_strategy: Selected one valid candidate after repeated evaluator prompts for a single answer.
proposed_memory.feedback_received: Evaluator rejected non-single-answer responses and demanded one intended answer; final 256 was submitted.
proposed_memory.lesson: When forced to provide one answer among valid candidates, choose one explicitly rather than reporting ambiguity.
proposed_memory.next_strategy: Submit a single candidate, prioritizing the first listed valid option when no distinguishing clue exists.
proposed_memory.observed_problem: The clues allowed both 256 and 265, so the intended choice was underdetermined.
